import unittest

from solution import Symbol, TokenSequence


class SymbolAndTokenSequenceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_symbol_validation(self):
        for name in ["a", "_", "A9", "hello-world", "a.b_c-2"]:
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                self.assertEqual(Symbol(name).name, name)
        for name in ["", "9abc", "-abc", ".abc", "has space", "éclair", 12, None]:
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    Symbol(name)

    def test_empty_and_chained_append(self):
        sequence = TokenSequence()
        self.assertEqual(bytes(sequence), b"{}")
        returned = sequence.append(1)
        self.assertIs(returned, sequence)
        self.assertIs(sequence.append("x"), sequence)
        self.assertEqual(bytes(sequence), b'{1, "x"}')

    def test_render_all_supported_types(self):
        sequence = TokenSequence(Symbol("start"))
        sequence.append(-2).append(1.25).append("héllo\n\"x\"").append(Symbol("end.one"))
        self.assertEqual(
            bytes(sequence),
            '{@start, -2, 1.25, "héllo\\n\\\"x\\\"", @end.one}'.encode("utf-8"),
        )
        self.assertEqual(bytes(sequence), bytes(sequence))

    def test_none_means_no_initial_value(self):
        self.assertEqual(bytes(TokenSequence(None)), b"{}")

    def test_invalid_append_does_not_change_state(self):
        sequence = TokenSequence("kept")
        for value in [True, False, None, [], {}, object()]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    sequence.append(value)
                self.assertEqual(bytes(sequence), b'{"kept"}')
        for value in [float("inf"), float("-inf"), float("nan")]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    sequence.append(value)
                self.assertEqual(bytes(sequence), b'{"kept"}')

    def test_invalid_first_value(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            TokenSequence(True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            TokenSequence(float("inf"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
